The European Handball Federation made a new decision about players’ clothing after there was controversy this summer. The women’s national beach handball team from Norway played in shorts instead of the usual bikini bottoms at a championship in Bulgaria. The Federation then gave the team a fine. This action brought a strong reaction from the public and many sport fans.

The team said they wanted the freedom to choose what to wear. The rules before asked women to wear bikini bottoms but men could play in shorts. Both players and supporters called the rule unfair. Many said the difference was not good for equal rights.

After discussions, the European Handball Federation said now women players can also wear tight shorts. These shorts must be “close fit” and go upwards to the thigh. The Federation hopes this will make more women feel comfortable to join the sport. The president of the Federation told CNN the change follows “many talks with teams and players.” He admitted that the old rule was not modern.

The Norwegian team said they are happy for the change. They believe women should decide about their own sports clothing. Other teams also expressed support. Some players said they prefer bikini bottoms for the hot weather and for better movement. But they still want the option to choose what is best for them.

The International Handball Federation said they will look at their own rules too. They may make similar changes soon. Some athletes say the problem is not just in handball. They see the same situation in other sports as well.

Many people feel the new rule is a step for women in sport. There could be more changes in the future for equal rules. For now, players are glad that their request was heard. They hope this will help all women feel respected in their activities.

In the southeastern corner of Australia, officials reported 42 new COVID-19 cases on Wednesday morning. Most of these cases concern the state of New South Wales, which now faces the strongest outbreak since the last year. The state government decided to keep the lockdown for another week at least. Many people are not happy with this decision. They are tired from the long period of limitations since June. State Premier Gladys Berejiklian said it is necessary. She explained that these measures are not easy, but they help to keep the numbers from growing very fast.

Shops and cafes in Sydney have been closed. Only essential services are working. Most residents must stay at home except for buying food or work that cannot be done from their house. Schools conduct online classes. Some families find it hard because not all children have fast internet or quiet space. Police check the streets and remind everyone about masks and distance rules.

Health officials continue to trace contacts of the new cases. They believe the Delta variant spreads quickly. There is worry that the outbreak can reach other parts of the country. In some areas of Sydney, more than half of the new infections are people under 35 years old. Vaccination is progressing slowly compared to other countries. Many ask for more vaccine deliveries.

Prime Minister Scott Morrison said the country must stay patient. He promised more support for businesses. The economic loss is already visible. Many small shops say they cannot wait much longer if the lockdown continues. Doctors say the main thing is to protect the health care system. Most hospital beds are still empty, but the number of patients is growing each day. Berejiklian asked everyone to keep following the rules. She also said the state can return to normal faster if people help each other.

David Brooks, a football player from Wales, received many messages of support after it was announced that he has been diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma. Brooks plays for Bournemouth, a club in the English Championship. The information became known this week. Brooks, who is 24 years old, has played several times for the Wales national team. Fans, players, and many people from different countries have expressed their sympathy on social media and in interviews.

Brooks said in a statement that he feels lucky because his illness was found early. He thanked the doctors and the medical staff. He also thanked Bournemouth and the Wales football association. He explained that he will begin treatment soon. He hopes that everything will go well. He wrote that he will do his best to return to playing football as soon as possible.

After the news came out, many clubs shared messages of encouragement. Bournemouth wrote that the whole club stands behind David in this hard period. They said that everyone is sending their strength to him and his family. Wales football association also said that they are with him. Teammates and coaches wrote their hope to see Brooks back playing very soon. Some players from other teams in the Championship also posted messages to wish him a speedy recovery.

In the next weeks, Brooks will not play football. His treatment will begin immediately. The doctors said that with early detection, Hodgkin lymphoma has good chances to be cured. Many people in the football community remember other players who also had health problems and returned to play. They believe Brooks will also be strong.

Supporters from Bournemouth and fans from Wales national team said that they are planning to show banners and wear shirts with messages for Brooks at the next games. They want him to know that he is not alone. On social media, hundreds of people posted comments. Some wrote about their own experiences with similar illnesses. Many said that football is not the most important thing now, but Brooks’s health and recovery.

Brooks’s story has reached many people outside the football world as well. Some local newspapers in Wales and England wrote about the situation. Medical experts explained that Hodgkin lymphoma is a type of cancer that affects the lymph system. They said that young people can recover if treatment begins early. Brooks’s case has helped to make more people aware of the disease.

While Brooks focuses on his health, his teammates said that they will work hard on the field. They want to win matches for him. Coaches told the media that Brooks is a strong person. They believe he will fight and come back soon. For now, everyone waits for good news about his health.

On the island of Samsø, wind is always present. Sometimes it blows strong, sometimes it is only a whisper. For people living here, wind is not only part of daily life. It is also the main provider of energy. The story of Samsø is known in many places. Many speak about how the small island tried, and mostly succeeded, to change how energy is used.

Before, Samsø was like most other places. People heated their homes with oil, cars ran on petrol, and electricity came from far away. Then, about twenty-five years ago, the people of Samsø wanted to try something else. They did not want to be the same as before. They wanted to see if wind and sun could replace oil and coal.

Søren Hermansen is a person who speaks much about this change. He says that the people at first were not sure. Change is often scary. “Many were worried,” Hermansen said. “They thought this would make life more hard, or more expensive. Some did not trust that wind and sun could be enough.”

But there were many meetings. People on the island talked, sometimes for hours. They discussed how the future should look. There was not agreement at the start. Some did not like the tall wind turbines that would be built. Some worried about their view. Some thought about birds. Others just did not like to change the routine.

In time, more people agreed to try. They decided to build several wind turbines. Some would be on land, some would stand in the sea near the coast. With money from both the island and the government, the first turbines began to spin. People could see the blades slicing the air. Children pointed and talked about them.

After some years, Samsø had so many wind turbines that the island produced more electricity than it used. The people said this was a surprise. Many thought it would not work so well. But the numbers were clear. There was enough wind power to send extra electricity to the main part of Denmark.

The change did not stop with turbines. Hermansen and others suggested new heating systems. They built heating plants that use straw from local farms. Instead of oil, houses now get heat from burning straw, or from the sun. Some homes have solar panels. Others use small electric heaters, powered by wind.

The result is that energy on Samsø comes mostly from local sources. The island almost does not use fossil fuel anymore. Only cars and some machines still need petrol or diesel. But even this is changing. Hermansen says more people now drive electric cars. The island has some charging stations, but not enough. “It is still a problem,” he says. “For some jobs you need a van or a tractor. Electric is not always possible.”

The change on Samsø brought attention from other places. People came from different countries to look. They ask how the islanders managed to agree. Hermansen says it was not easy. “Every person had their own idea,” he said. “You must listen. You must be patient. Most important is that people feel it is their project.”

Wind energy shapes life in many small ways. Some days, the wind is too strong and the turbines have to slow down. Other days, there is little wind and electricity comes from batteries or from the straw plant. People say they have learned to live with changes in weather and energy.

Climate is a big topic everywhere now. Hermansen is often invited to speak. He tells how Samsø became nearly carbon-neutral. He says that it is possible even for small places. “If a small island can do it, then others can too,” he says.

Not all is easy. Some on the island say the work is not finished. While electricity is nearly all green, transport is still behind. Boats and some vehicles are still using diesel. A few farmers want to keep their old equipment. Change is slow in some parts.

There is also the cost. At first, many worried that green energy would be more expensive. In the early years, the wind turbines were costly. Now, Hermansen says, costs are more stable. People pay less for heat, sometimes less for electricity. The price goes up and down with the weather, but overall it is better than before.

Children in the school learn about energy from a young age. They visit the wind turbines and see how they work. Some students come from other places for special classes. A teacher said, “It is normal for our children. They grow up with wind and solar.” For them, renewable energy is not strange.

Tourists also visit Samsø because of the energy story. Some ride bicycles to look at the turbines. Many take photos. The local shops sell T-shirts and mugs with windmill pictures. For some, the change has helped the local economy.

There have been some problems. A few times, the wind turbines stopped working in bad weather. The island had to use backup

A new discovery about ancient disease in humans was announced last week. Some scientists in Europe found bones from a man who lived thousands of years ago. They said this man had a disease that is now not common. The bones were uncovered in a cave in Southern Germany. The researchers explained that the skeleton is very old, from a period when Neanderthals and modern humans lived near each other. This makes the finding special.

The leader of the research team, Dr. Haeusler, spoke to the press. He said the disease was found through careful looking at the skeleton. The man had bone growths that do not form in healthy bodies. These growths are similar to problems seen in old animals and humans today. The scientists think the man had a long-term sickness that affected his movement. He could have struggled to walk or move his arms easily.

The disease is sometimes found in animals. For example, elephants and some big cats can show the same kind of bone change. The scientists were surprised to see it in such an old human. There are very few skeletons from this time that carry signs of disease. This may mean that these ancient people did not live long lives. It is also possible that the healthy ones were more likely to survive and be buried in safe places.

The researchers said the disease could be related to how people lived then. They hunted large animals and ate meat. This might have made them more exposed to sickness from animals. Also, the food was sometimes not cooked enough. This could have helped diseases to move between animals and people. Dr. Haeusler said that they cannot know exactly how the man got sick. The bones only show what happened in his body for the last years of his life.

Neanderthals and early modern humans were different, but they lived close together sometimes. Scientists found that some genes from Neanderthals are still with us today. These genes can help with fighting sickness, but some can also bring problems. The discovery from Germany may help in understanding which diseases were present in the past and how humans got strong against them.

From looking at the skeleton, the team made guesses about the man’s life. He was not very old when he died, maybe around thirty years. The illness made his bones thick and uneven. It did not kill him quickly. The scientists think he suffered from pain for many years. It was a slow disease.

Inside the cave, the bones were found with some stone tools. This can mean that the man was still working and living with others until late in his life. In early human groups, sick people were sometimes cared for by the healthy. There are other places where skeletons with injuries show signs of healing. This means that the group did not leave their weak members alone.

Many questions remain open about the disease. The researchers are not sure if it came from eating sick animals, or if it happened from some other problem. They want to compare this skeleton with others found in Europe and Asia. If more old bones show the same signs, then the disease could have been common. But if not, the case from Germany may be rare.

Dr. Haeusler said that finding disease in old bones is difficult work. Bones must be in good condition to see the changes. In some places, wet soil destroys the skeletons. Also, not every disease leaves a mark on bone. Only the ones that last long time or change the shape will show up. The scientists hope that with better tools, more discoveries will be possible.

This finding is important for science. It helps researchers know more about daily life in very old times. People living then faced many dangers, not only from animals and weather, but also from sickness. The study of the bones from Germany will continue. The team will try to learn more by testing the material with new machines. They also plan to visit other caves in the area.

The scientists said they will share more information later this year. For now, the main lesson is that ancient humans were not so different from us. Disease was there, just like today. The study reminds us that people have always needed to face sickness and survive, even thousands of years ago.

In the last week, many people who are seeking loans have found that credit scores are causing confusion. A man who wanted to buy a house explained his situation. He said his score was not high enough for the mortgage company. He spoke about feeling frustrated. He wondered why one number can decide such an important outcome.

Another person also shared his experience. He tried to apply for a loan to buy a car. When he checked his credit, he found three different scores from three different agencies. None matched the numbers given by the bank. He said he didn’t know which score mattered. It was not easy for him to understand what happened.

There are many people who find the credit score system confusing. The system relies on complex calculations that most people cannot understand easily. One bank employee explained that scores depend on payment history, debt amounts, and other things. She said customers ask why scores are different in every place. She said banks do not give clear answers. It makes people feel uncertain.

Many mortgage companies have strict rules about scores. They want customers to have higher numbers. One company said they require a score of at least 700 for best rates. If the score is lower, the interest rate goes up. A woman who wanted to buy a house said she had no missed payments, but her score was still low. She said she felt unfairly judged.

Some experts say scores are not perfect. They point out that scores can change quickly. If one person misses one payment by accident, the score will drop. Sometimes scores are not accurate. Errors can happen in reports. One expert said mistakes are common. He advised people to check their reports often.

People who borrow money find more problems. If their scores are low, banks may refuse to lend. Sometimes banks agree to give loans, but the rates are less good. One man said he accepted a loan with high interest. He hoped to pay it off fast, but he worried that his score would not improve. He said he felt trapped.

There are new rules coming. Some governments want to change how scores are made. They think the system should be easier to understand. They want banks to explain to customers what affects scores. One official said people have a right to know. He said rules will make companies share more information.

Not everyone agrees with changes. Some loan companies say scores help them judge risk. If customers know too much about the system, they may try to trick it. One manager said it is better for companies to keep some secrets. He said lending is safer that way. Some people say this attitude is not fair.

There are other problems with credit scores. For some people, the numbers are low for reasons they cannot control. If someone never had a loan before, the score is low. If someone moves to another country, the score does not follow. Young people say the system does not help them start. One student said he could not get a card from the bank. He felt he had to wait many years.

Some data from banks show more people are asking for help. They want to improve their scores. Many banks offer advice, but it is not always useful. Some banks tell people to pay bills on time. Others say to reduce debts. One banker said advice is often too simple. He said people need more support.

Some community groups are trying to help. They teach people how to read reports. They explain how scores work. One volunteer said she meets people every week. She said many people do not know their score until they are refused credit. She said the system is not friendly.

Technology is used by some companies to check scores faster. They use computers to look at reports. Sometimes mistakes are found, but not always fixed. One customer said he saw an error, but the company did not fix it. He had to call many times. He felt tired after each call.

There are stories of people who tried hard to improve their scores. One woman paid all her debts. She waited for her score to rise. She found that after some time, her score still did not go up. She did not understand why. She said banks gave no explanation.

Some people want the system to change. They say one number should not decide everything. They want more ways to show that a person can pay. One idea is to look at rent payments or phone bills. Some countries have tried this. Officials say it helps some people, but not all.

There are many ways people try to avoid problems with scores. Some use cash instead of loans. Others find people to help them co-sign. One man said his father signed for him. He said it helped, but he does not want to rely on others.

Credit scores affect many parts of life. If the score is low, it is harder to buy a house or a car. Some jobs check scores before hiring. One woman said her employer asked for her score. She felt embarrassed. She said she does not know why it is important.

Several countries in Europe are deciding on new measures to slow the latest coronavirus wave. Many of these measures focus on people who are not vaccinated. The governments say it is important to control the new wave before winter comes. Some countries are changing rules because the number of cases is rising fast. Hospitals are starting to prepare for more patients. Experts worry that the health system could be under pressure if the number of new infections keeps going up. The main places with concern are in Central and Eastern Europe, but several Western European countries are also watching the situation closely.

In Germany, leaders are discussing if they should make new restrictions for people who have not received a vaccine. The number of daily infections is higher than before. Health officials warn that the situation is becoming difficult. In Austria, the government has announced stricter controls for the unvaccinated. Only people who are vaccinated or have recovered from Covid-19 can enter restaurants, bars, and other public places. The government of the country says these steps are needed to protect hospitals. Some citizens worry about fairness and personal choice, but many agree that the health system must be protected.

France has increased the pressure on people to get vaccinated. The country already uses a health pass to enter many places like cinemas, museums, and cafes. Authorities now plan to check this health pass more often. The president asks people not to wait for the next wave, but to get vaccinated now. The officials say vaccination rates are high but must go higher to stop a new wave from causing more problems. In Italy, politicians are talking about making vaccines mandatory for more workers. Some people already need a special certificate for work, but there is a discussion about extending this to more groups.

Poland and Slovakia are both seeing increasing numbers of daily cases. Hospitals in these countries are warning about the possibility of more severe cases soon. The government in Poland is asking people to get the vaccine. The authorities say vaccination is free and available for all adults. Still, a large number of people are choosing not to do it. In Slovakia, leaders talk about needing new measures very soon. There is worry that the vaccination rate is still too low to keep the hospitals safe if the wave becomes stronger.

In Hungary, the authorities are now strongly recommending the vaccine. They also ask older citizens to take extra care. In Romania, the medical system is already in a very hard place. The number of deaths is high each day. The health minister says that vaccination is the main solution. He asks all Romanians to trust the new vaccines. The government tries to set up more places for people to get vaccinated easily. Doctors and nurses are working long hours. Some international help has arrived with medical supplies.

The European Union is watching the situation. Officials ask all member countries to do more for vaccination campaigns. The goal is to stop the new wave from becoming even worse. The European health agency warns that the danger is not over. They say that winter can make the virus spread more quickly. Cold weather means people spend more time inside. The agency recommends ventilation and masks in closed places. They stress that vaccines work well against severe cases and death, but countries must act soon.

Some countries started booster campaigns. Older people and those with weak health can get extra vaccine doses. Scientists say this will help to keep protection high. There are discussions about how often boosters are needed. Each country is deciding for itself about this. Some leaders say it is better to act fast. Others worry about public opinion. Still, the wave is forcing quick decisions.

Many citizens in Europe are discussing the new rules. Some people feel the measures are too strong. Others say the rules are not strong enough. Street protests have happened in some cities. Most leaders ask for calm and patience. They say the vaccine is the key to a normal life. They repeat that more vaccination will stop new measures. The approach is different in each country. But the hope is the same. Leaders want to end the wave and prevent new ones.

Experts say the situation changes fast. New variants could appear and make the situation harder. The World Health Organization asks for global cooperation. They point out that the pandemic is still present everywhere. European countries now watch each other. They hope that with more vaccination and some new measures, the health system will not break. Winter is coming soon. All countries want to avoid a repeat of last year. The next few weeks will be important for Europe.

On Thursday in Tokyo, several officials spoke about the participation of women in various games and events that are organized during this year. The concern has been expressed about the number of women involved in these activities. According to Mr. Mori, who is responsible for one organizing committee, people should be aware of the challenges facing women who want to join. He said that often women are not encouraged enough, and this is due to many reasons.

Some people in Japan say that there are obstacles for women to get an equal chance. They believe it happens because tradition still influences decisions. Many games and events in Tokyo have rules that are not easy for everyone. Mr. Mori said that changes are being discussed but progress is slow. He mentioned that older members of organizations sometimes do not listen to new ideas. This makes it harder for young women who want to compete or participate in games.

A report from last year showed that only a small percentage of women managed to enter important competitions held in Tokyo. Many women said they felt excluded and uncomfortable. According to several participants, the language used in meetings makes it difficult for them to speak freely. They believe that encouraging more women can improve the quality of events. Some officials agreed but did not know how to fix these problems. Mr. Mori explained that there is some pressure from international groups for Japan to increase the number of women in games. He said changes would happen, but it would take time.

The committee responsible for planning the events said that they try to give equal opportunity to all people. But many women complained that the environment is not friendly. They mentioned that committees are mostly led by men, and their opinions are ignored. One participant said that when women suggest ideas, they are not taken seriously. This situation has made it harder for women in Tokyo to become part of games or organizations.

Some people pointed out that even media coverage about games often focuses on men. Female athletes and participants said they are rarely asked for their opinions. They think the attitudes in Japan are still too conservative. According to Ms. Takahashi, who works with the organizing committee, there has been improvement but not enough. She said it is necessary that women feel safe and respected. She also mentioned that the rules for joining games should be changed to include more people.

The government released a statement, saying that they hope to see more women involved in sports and games. Officials said they are working with different committees to make changes. Some experts believe that Japan must change its approach quickly or risk falling behind other countries. They said that fair treatment for women is important for the reputation of Tokyo events. Young women who want to join these games said that sometimes they are discouraged from participating by their families.

There have been public discussions about the issue. Some people in Japan criticized Mr. Mori’s comments, saying that he did not support enough actions. They called for more transparency in organizing events. Others said that even in schools, young girls are not encouraged to play games or compete. According to several teachers, there is a need for more education and better support for women. They think that only with more efforts can Japan achieve equality in games.

The organizing committee announced that they will hold more meetings with women to listen to their concerns. Officials said they want to learn from other countries where women participate more freely. Mr. Mori said he hopes for more balance in the future. He repeated that it is not easy to change old habits in Tokyo. Some participants said that they want stronger rules to protect women’s rights. They demanded that committees include more female members.

Many people expect that there will be small changes in the next few years. Some women said they are waiting for real action, not just promises. They believe that if the situation does not improve, games in Tokyo will lose popularity. Organizers said they are aware of the risk but hope to find solutions. As discussions continue, the focus remains on increasing the number of women and providing a safer environment for all people who join games in Japan.

The first time I saw snow, I was not at home. I wasn’t even in my own country. I was a student, living in a small city in Germany, confused by the way the sky stayed gray all day, and by how silent the streets became when it snowed. That year, I learned to think differently. I had always assumed people everywhere had the same way of doing things. But as I struggled to shop for groceries and tried to join conversations at the university, I kept realizing how much I didn’t know. It was uncomfortable. Sometimes, I felt like a child again—awkward, unsure, and desperate to fit in.

But there’s a kind of education you get just by being away from home. Most of it has nothing to do with classes. I learned to cook with what I could find. I got used to hearing five languages at the bus stop. I started to see how other students felt about their countries, their traditions, and their own families. I started asking questions instead of making assumptions. The best thing about living in a foreign country is that it shakes you awake. You pay attention. You realize you have so much more to learn, not just about others, but about yourself. That’s something no textbook ever taught me.

I remember being surprised when I first learned about the percentage of the world’s population living in just a few countries. It was a hot afternoon in my seventh grade geography class, and the teacher tapped numbers onto the old chalkboard: India, China, the USA. She said that together, India and China house almost 36% of everyone. That’s a lot. More than a third, squeezed into two countries on a globe full of nations. The USA, with so much news and movies focused on it, is far behind them in pure numbers. That fact still shakes me. I started wondering how much space people actually have in those giant countries. It’s strange to realize that people in China and India are, just by chance, much more likely to meet someone from their own country than I ever will. These percentages—sometimes they reveal a lot more about how people live than the facts themselves.

I remember being twelve and thinking forty was ancient. Back then, age felt like a distant, irrelevant number. But everything changes when people start talking about age groups in charts and reports. Suddenly, you find yourself looking for your own number. Men and women get separated into their lines and bars, sometimes with dramatic differences that feel too neat for real life. I laugh a little when I see that “old” now means someone a decade younger than my father. These categories are neat, but people aren’t. Sometimes a thirty-year-old is more tired than a sixty-year-old. I have an aunt who runs marathons at seventy, and a friend who wants nothing more than to nap at twenty-five. So when I see a chart showing men and women at different years and ages, I always wonder what’s really going on behind those numbers. Age, group, gender—those are just starting points. Living, not counting, is the part that matters. People always find ways to surprise you, whatever their number is.
